title: Keynote: KubeCon Opening Keynote - Kelsey Hightower, Google
summary: Kelsey Hightower's opening keynote at KubeCon, delivered as a live-demo style talk about Kubernetes and cloud-native tooling.
why: HN mentions it mainly as an example of Hightower's live-demo keynotes and a demo of pull-request-driven promotion and deployment.

quote.text: Kelsey Hightower talked about it and and has demoed the workflow of using pull requests to initiate promotion and deployments.
